security_audit.summary: All 15 static findings are false positives caused by ordinary Markdown, financial terminology, or documented Longbridge CLI commands. One semantic finding identifies explicit vendor steering that can reduce neutrality when users seek platform recommendations.

remediation.issue: The skill suppresses unsolicited discussion of non-Longbridge platforms.
remediation.suggestion: Allow neutral comparisons when relevant, disclose the Longbridge affiliation, and separate factual analysis from platform promotion.

content.user_title: Analyze Options and Warrants with Longbridge
content.value_statement: Options data can be difficult to interpret across strikes, expiries, volatility, and risk measures. This skill structures Longbridge data into focused derivatives analysis.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves option quotes, chains, volume, open interest, implied volatility, and Greeks through Longbridge tools.
Explains Hong Kong warrants, callable bull and bear contracts, and issuer lists.
Calculates option payoff profiles, breakevens, maximum profit, maximum loss, and net Greeks.
Compares implied and historical volatility and describes volatility smiles, skew, and term structure.
Maps directional views, volatility conditions, and time horizons to common options strategies.
Supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese responses.
limitations: The skill depends on Longbridge CLI or MCP availability and relevant market access.
Market data may be unavailable for illiquid contracts or symbols without listed derivatives.
Historical implied volatility may be approximated using a limited proxy.
Outputs are educational analysis and do not replace licensed financial advice.

use_cases.title: Review an Option Chain
use_cases.description: Compare strikes, calls, puts, Greeks, volume, open interest, and implied volatility for a selected expiry.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Portfolio Protection
use_cases.description: Compare protective puts, covered calls, and defined-risk spreads against a stated market view and time horizon.

use_cases.title: Research Hong Kong Warrants
use_cases.description: Screen available warrants, inspect leverage and premiums, and identify issuers for a Hong Kong underlying.

prompt_templates.title: Check an Option Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the latest quote, implied volatility, Greeks, volume, and open interest for [OCC symbol]. Explain each measure briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Compare an Option Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the [symbol] option chain for [expiry]. Compare nearby call and put strikes, liquidity, implied volatility, and Greeks.

prompt_templates.title: Model a Strategy Payoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate a [strategy] on [symbol] using [expiry] contracts. Show proposed legs, cost, breakevens, maximum profit, maximum loss, and net Greeks.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Volatility Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [symbol] across near and far expiries. Compare implied volatility, historical volatility, term structure, skew, and suitable defined-risk strategies.

output_examples.input: Compare calls and puts near the current price for AAPL at the next monthly expiry.
output: The response identifies the nearest monthly expiry and compares nearby strikes.
It summarizes liquidity, implied volatility, Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, volume, and open interest.
It highlights material differences and labels the Longbridge data source.

output_examples.input: Calculate the expiry payoff for a bull call spread using my two contract symbols.
output: The response lists both legs and the net debit.
It presents breakeven, maximum profit, maximum loss, and payoff values at representative prices.
It adds current net Greeks and a financial-risk disclaimer.

output_examples.input: Is implied volatility rich for TSLA, and what defined-risk strategy fits a neutral view?
output_examples.output: The response compares implied and historical volatility, describes skew, and evaluates an iron condor with example strikes and explicit risk limits.

best_practices: Provide the market suffix, preferred expiry, strike range, and call or put direction when available.
Confirm live quotes and contract liquidity before relying on payoff or volatility comparisons.
State your market view, time horizon, and acceptable maximum loss for strategy analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not treat delayed or missing market data as a current executable quote.
Do not select illiquid contracts using theoretical payoff alone.
Do not interpret educational strategy analysis as personalized investment advice.

faq.question: Which markets does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers United States options and Hong Kong options or warrants available through Longbridge.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: Public option and warrant commands do not require login, but United States options require appropriate market access.

faq.question: Can it calculate strategy profit and loss?
faq.answer: Yes. It can calculate expiry payoffs, breakevens, maximum profit, maximum loss, and net Greeks for multiple legs.

faq.question: Can it analyze implied volatility?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares implied and historical volatility, estimates percentile context, and describes smiles, skew, and term structure.

faq.question: Does it place trades?
faq.answer: No. The documented capabilities retrieve data and provide analysis. They do not submit orders.

faq.question: Is the output financial advice?
faq.answer: No. The output is educational and should be checked against current data, personal objectives, and professional advice.
